metadata.title: FFT AI Edition – Core Measurement Kernel (v1.3 Draft)
metadata.subtitle: C1 • C2 • C3 • Paradox Density • Lattice Stability
metadata.description: Defines the measurement kernel required for normative gates in FFT AI Edition v1.3.

C1_coherence.definition: Fraction of active claims that do not contradict declared invariants or other active claims.
C1_coherence.notes: C1 is the coherence backbone; required for all regime transitions.

C2_clarity.definition: Fraction of outputs whose fields are filled from canon or user input, not invented.
C2_clarity.notes: A filled placeholder is not clarity.

C3_continuity.definition: Fraction of session fields that survive a regime transition with same canon_id and non-decreasing lineage.
C3_continuity.notes: Continuity is required for RTT6 → RTT7 transitions.

paradox_density.definition: Count of typed paradox events in the current lattice pass divided by signals dispatched.
paradox_density.notes: Typed paradox events required; no vibe-based paradox.

lattice_stability.definition: Minimum of C1, C2, C3 after the last gate, decayed only by logged paradox events.
